name: The Big Cube Melbourne 2025
information: ### Information: The GUTS team will be organising lots of games and activites inside for all ages, catering for families and competitors! Spectators are permitted and may enter at a charge of $5 per family. Competitors are encouraged to bring all guests together in order to pay the single charge for everyone. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Kaurna people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
